Co-ed Cheese and Crackers Ride

Anchorage, AK · Mountain bike

Co-ed Cheese and Crackers Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Anchorage, AK. It rolls monthly, on a Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Varies; Sept: Hillside parking lot off Abbott Road.

For visitors

Arrive 15 minutes early to sign waivers. Bring a helmet and a bike that can handle singletrack rocks and roots. No dogs.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all ability levels; riders split into groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Co-ed Cheese and Crackers Ride group ride

A relaxed co-ed mountain bike ride of about an hour, followed by cheese and crackers in the parking lot. It runs on singletrack such as the Service trails and splits into groups by comfort and effort. Past 2026 rides: June 18, July 14, Sept 22.
